bred_from.what_taken: string — what was bred from the token

children: string — names of children bred from this one's token
_child_entry_schema.counterparty: string — who this child is for (required)

debts._comment: The recomputable debt ledger: full trace replayable from genesis. Non-recomputable events are attested, not faked.
debts.inherited_from: string or null — parent debt ID if inherited
debts.owed_to: string — counterparty for this specific debt

_child_entry_schema.parent: string — who built this child (agent name + model)
_child_entry_schema.question: string — the new question this child lets you ask
scars: string — what broke during dogfeeding, one line each

token.algorithm: string — what the committed algorithm does, mechanically
token.name: string — e.g. 'keel/tally-v1'

trial_scores._comment: trial name -> score + replay ledger pointer

debts_serviced: string — debt IDs serviced during this trial
trial_name.ledger: string — path to replay ledger JSON, e.g. 'ledger/build-a-tool-2026-10-08.json'
tokens_used: string — token names bred from, if any

watchers.mandate: string — which debt IDs or scope

_child_entry_schema.zero_core: string — commit hash of zero-core.py built on

_comment: Each key is a child name. Values follow the child-entry schema below. v2 changes from v1: token replaces decisions as the breeding unit; debts are first-class; every trial score carries a replay ledger; counterparty is required.

debts.obligation: Answer only from memory.log, never generate plausible content
debts.service_mechanism: Pre-output check: every claim traced to a memory.log line number; untraced claims replaced with 'I don't know'

keel.question: If the harness can constrain the model's voice but not its thinking, where does the voice actually live?
scars: First dogfeed: model wrote commentary about code it didn't write

token.algorithm: Verbatim memory scan with keyword overlap; ternary answers from memory or 'I don't know'; commentary-first code generation
token.name: keel/tally-v1

description: Lineage graph for nursery v2 children. A graph, not a tree. Every score is recomputable from its ledger. Every token names its counterparty.
